label: R24 PILOT/DEVELOPMENT: VCS/BCE drop-in for CoMIR InfoNCE; BF-SHG primary (FIT32 / CAL8 / DEV32), EPFL RGB-NIR secondary; no TEST
authorization: User 2026-10-26 「都要做，你来规划实验，实现，并提交」 after the SOTA analysis (REGISTRATION_SOTA_ANALYSIS_CN.md): replace the SOTA framework component with VCS.
question: Inside the official CoMIR framework (a published SOTA for BF-SHG), does replacing its InfoNCE objective with the VCS objective (same bounded-critic optimum family as BCE) improve registration? CoMIR's own paper shows the critic choice changes SIFT success from 38.8% to 56.0% (strict), so the objective is not neutral in this framework.

arms.nce_mse: original InfoNCE over 2B points, s_ij = -||x_i-x_j||^2/D/tau, same-modality negatives included (CoMIR as published)
arms.vcs_exp: T_ij = 2 exp(-||a_i-b_j||^2/D/tau) - 1 on cross-modal pairs; J = mean_i[T_ii - T_ii^2/2] - mean_{i!=j}[T_ij + T_ij^2/2]; loss -J (P diagonal, Q off-diagonal cross-modal = empirical product of marginals)
arms.bce_exp: balanced BCE, P(+) = (1+T)/2 on the vcs_exp T
arms.bce_cos: balanced BCE on the vcs_cos T

unchanged: data stream (sample RNG 3000+seed), initialisation (official comir_models(seed)), augmentation, rotation trick, regularisers, optimiser, steps, registration, evaluation problems. nce_mse is the original code path (bitwise CPU check).

cal_selection.seed_note: V10 CAL seed convention (deviation from the brief's 1001, so finals 1001-1003 are not the selection seed)
cal_selection.grid: tau in {0.1, 0.5, 2.0} (lr .01) for nce_mse, nce_cos, vcs_exp, bce_exp; lr in {0.01, 0.003} for vcs_cos, bce_cos (no tau) = 16 runs, each trained 736 steps and evaluated on CAL8 x 10 at step 736
cal_selection.rule: per family lexicographic: CAL success<42 desc, success<9 desc, median err asc, grid order; best critic per objective (VCS: vcs_exp vs vcs_cos; NCE: nce_mse vs nce_cos; BCE: bce_exp vs bce_cos) chosen by the same rule over the two selected configs

finals: the 6 selected configs x seeds 1001-1003 (BF), training 736 steps, CAL and DEV32 x 10 at step 736; plus nce_mse tau .5 lr .01 at 1001-1003 if not selected (reproduction of V10 CoMIR_native, paired with its stored DEV rows)
epfl: secondary transfer: the 6 BF-selected configs x 1001-1003 trained on the EPFL FIT windows with the V10 EPFLCoMIRTrainer, DEV74 (72 scene units, unit macro via v10.epfl.production.dev_statistics); no EPFL-specific selection
primary: BF DEV32 strict success<9 (pooled over 320 = core macro), seed-paired
signal_rule: descriptive: best-critic VCS - best-critic NCE >= +3 pp strict, >= 2/3 seeds positive, loose<42 not worse by > 1 pp; VCS - BCE reported separately (a VCS-specific claim needs VCS > BCE too)
secondary: all arms vs reused V10 CoMIR_native DEV rows
CoMIR-protocol (834 patch, +-30 deg / +-100 px, SIFT / alpha-AMD on representations) once the B fork harness exists
hardware: --partition=L40S --exclude=node51,node53,node60 for every arm (deviation from the 3-partition brief: matched to the V10 CoMIR_native environment so arms share one GPU type); precision/environment asserted equal to the V10 BF1 protocol
budget: ~0.1-0.2 GPUh per unit; 16 CAL + 18-21 BF finals + 18 EPFL finals ~ 8-10 GPUh; hard 2 h per job; cap 30 GPUh
no_retry: failed attempts are kept and reviewed, never silently rerun
limits: registration readout fixed to the CoMIR_native -MSE latent energy for every arm (cosine-trained latents are scale-free; disclosed)
DEV reused development data; position search non-deterministic
